notes: Choosing a clock face now shows you the clocks. It was a dropdown listing six words — Digital, Minimal, Classic, Bars, Dots, Ring — which asked you to guess what each one looked like.

It is now a gallery of six tiles, each running a real, ticking clock built by the same renderer the panel uses. What you preview is exactly what you get, and turning the second hand on or off redraws the previews so that choice can be…

The weather icon and temperature now sit together as one centred group. The temperature had been pushed to the far side of the panel, leaving a gap in the middle and reading as two unrelated things at opposite ends rather than one reading.
